name: Kenny Dink - Moalboal
summary: Booked-court pickleball venue in Upper Tunga with an online scheduling system.
description:
Kenny Dink - Moalboal is a pickleball venue in Upper Tunga, Moalboal, run through an online court-booking portal rather than casual walk-in play.

Check the booking site directly for current court count, open session times and rates before planning a visit, since availability is managed entirely through the online schedule.
